scripts.test: bun run --filter '@hiai-docs/sdk' build && bun test --path-ignore-patterns="*node_modules*" src
scripts.test:contract:scoped-live: bun run --filter '@hiai-docs/sdk' build && bun run test:contract:generate-client && ATTACHMENT_PRESIGN_EXPIRY_SECONDS=60 bun test tests/integration/scoped-public-surfaces.test.ts
scripts.test:contract:generate-client: openapi-typescript ../../docs/openapi.json -o build/openapi-paths.ts && tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ESNext --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler tests/integration/openapi-client.ts
